:::{#thm-outer-product-trace}
#### The trace of an outer product is a dot product

For two vectors $\vecf{u}$ and $\vecf{v}$ with the same number $n$ of entries,
the [trace](#def-trace)
of the [outer product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-outer-product) $\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}$
and the [dot product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-dot-product) $\tprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}$
are the same number:

$$
\trf{\underbrace{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}}_{n \times n}}
= \tprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}
$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\trf{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}}
&= \sumto{i}{n} \paren{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}}_{ii}
&& \text{(definition of the trace)}
\\
&= \sumto{i}{n} u_i v_i
&& \text{(entries of an outer product)}
\\
&= \tprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}
&& \text{(definition of the dot product)}
\ea
$$

:::
